create_predictive_sampling_planner: create a predictive_sampling.Planner instance with model, cost, noise_scale, horizon, nspline, nsample, and interp parameters
run_mpc_rollout: run a JIT-compiled MPC rollout with planner, policy, random key, model, and simulation data
get_models_and_cost_fn: get simulation model, planning model, and cost function from the handover bimanual task
